scope_statement: A plural, independent MAS tradition study spanning distributed problem solving, formal/public communication, task and team coordination, strategic interaction, organisations/norms, distributed reasoning, learning, robustness and contemporary human/LLM-agent translation. Completeness is bounded to the examined domain families and 76 registered candidate claims, not all publications or a claim of field-wide consensus.
scope_boundaries: No requester repositories, runtime designs, earlier Evolved packets or sibling corpora were consulted. Static prompt provenance is not evidence.
Distributed systems results enter only where a MAS source explicitly uses or motivates them; there is no general distributed-systems audit or blanket Byzantine terminology.
Robotics/control, AI logic, economics and organisational engineering are examined at documented MAS intersections, not as independently complete sibling traditions.
No catalogue of current software products, all FIPA implementations, all voting/mechanism variants, every MARL algorithm or every AAMAS paper is claimed.
Current evidence includes selected 2025–2026 research, current-year source discovery and version verification through the cut-off; proceedings indexing is not paper-level inspection.
LLM results are not the definition of MAS. Formal model properties, simulated behaviour, field trials, implementation and causal benefit are kept distinct.
An examined unresolved access/version question is not silently recast as disproof; selected whole-system transfer remains unvalidated.
evidence_limits: Completeness is bounded to the ten examined mandatory domain families and 76 registered candidates, not every publication or a field-wide consensus.

The 56 source records include 52 targeted full-text inspections, one institutional history page, one proceedings index/contents and two unavailable exact-version FIPA leads. Targeted inspection is not full reading or independent re-proving of every page and appendix.
EMAS-013 remains UNRESOLVED for current FIPA profile/implementation equivalence. The inspected experimental XC00037H specimen is not substituted for inaccessible final profiles.

Formal guarantees remain confined to their models. In particular, protocol completion possibility is not eventual work, and fault-tolerant replication does not strengthen an approximate optimiser into an exact one.

Field/deployment reports, staged trials, benchmark comparisons, implementation examples and 2026 preprints are distinct evidence. Shared programmes, authors, datasets, frameworks and models do not establish independent replication.

The four composition-induced properties and whole composed system are researcher synthesis. Fifteen discriminating cases include twelve analytical tests and three published component cases; none establishes end-to-end empirical validation of the whole synthesis.
The counterexample to strict information-loss/classification-error ordering is researcher analysis, not a published correction of EMAS-S037.
Sibling corpora and requester repositories were not consulted. No cross-trifecta synthesis, target-native crosswalk, adoption or mutation is established.

substantive_acceptance_gates.basis: Ten examined families, 25 dated nodes and 25 classified genealogy edges; attribution and access limits explicit.
24 criticism records and 17 transitions distinguish documented developments from analytical narrowing.
Selected 2025–2026 primary research and exact-version checks included; search scope and date limits recorded.
Ten developed models and all ten domain-profile dimensions on every candidate, with internally resolvable references.
76 stable candidate IDs, 76 examined, all primary dispositions reconciled, including one unresolved and nine rejected/ceremonial candidates.
12 focused ceremony records and 76 candidate-specific minimum/consumer/retirement entries.
Separate provenance, theory, comparison, field, replication, contrary and transfer partitions; 19 empirical/field/implementation records and 14 formal records.
Ten selection tensions, negative/null findings and a criticism of an anti-MAS argument alter or restrict judgements.
Twelve analytical nodes, 61 guarded relations, six alternative configurations, external/revision boundaries and five explicit composition/transfer obligations.
All 76 IDs accounted for; 66 conditional candidates developed and ten negative/ceremonial/unresolved guards enumerated.
Independent introduction, citation-ready claims, limits and page outline; no requester-system name.
76 globally keyed exports, documented intersections and questions for unread lanes; no cross-trifecta conclusion.
8348 fresh structural, field, count, ID, pointer and consistency checks passed.

review_boundary: The substantive review and adversarial adjudication were performed in this research execution. Automated checks establish structural and referential consistency, not scientific truth or independent peer review.
readiness_boundary: Ready as a bounded external research corpus, not an adoption decision or proof of whole-system effectiveness.
archive_membership_rule: Exactly these eight payloads plus this manifest; no bulk copyrighted sources, repository files, credentials or private execution logs.
hash_policy: SHA-256 over exact payload bytes. This manifest inventories neither itself nor the enclosing ZIP. The final ZIP hash/size and reopen result are recorded externally.
archive_verification_policy: The publication receipt is issued only after the ZIP has been closed, freshly reopened, CRC-tested, checked for exact membership and compared byte-for-byte and by SHA-256 with this manifest.
prefreeze_revision_log: All changes occurred before first freeze EMAS-R1; there was no earlier frozen packet whose judgements were silently changed.

Verified/corrected source dates, author lists, exact titles and experimental-versus-final FIPA identity from readable primary covers/text; DOI/deposit/file-name dates were not substituted for publication dates.
Added distinct candidates EMAS-075/076 after current primary research; retained all earlier IDs and unfavourable candidates.
Added EMAS-S054 and refined existing communication/human-participation candidates; did not manufacture a new candidate for an already represented trigger.
Classified Dung argumentation as an interdisciplinary import; retained strictness criticism EMAS-K018 as researcher analysis, not a published correction.
Machine serialisation uses UTF-8, two-space JSON indentation and final newline. Such syntax normalisation does not change the frozen substantive judgement.

A final genealogy check found no support for the draft Dung-to-foundations-manuscript edge. Read EMAS-S055/056 and replaced that edge with the express 2000 MAS dialogue adaptation. Refined EMAS-046, criticism EMAS-K013 and new relation EMAS-REL-061; the complete candidate denominator remains 76 because this is the operating-method coupling of an already registered criterion, not a distinct universally prescribed control.

Final primary-cover check completed the EMAS-S043 author list and December 2016 date; tightened the EMAS-075 fault-model wording to synchronous message passing. Normalised the staged-field-trial evidence-role label without altering its evidence status.

Final adjudication made every evolution transition’s historical-versus-analytical status explicit, so tested overgeneralisations are not falsely attributed to original authors. Export fields with no dedicated pairwise alternative edge received a reasoned absence note. A verification false positive inside the legitimate DOI JZVR6522 was corrected by matching whole target-code tokens, not by changing the citation.
